description: Helper functions for testing 'git read-tree' operations, including success/failure conditions and dry-run checks.

methods.name: read_tree_must_succeed
methods.description: Checks that 'git read-tree' succeeds and does not modify index or working tree when used with '-n' and the provided arguments.

methods.name: read_tree_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that 'git read-tree' fails with the provided arguments and ensures no changes to index.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Checks that 'git read-tree -n' succeeds and does not modify index or working tree, also comparing diff outputs.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that 'git read-tree -n' fails with the provided arguments and ensures no changes to index or working tree, comparing diff outputs.
